title: The Oka property for every complex K3 surface
exact_target: For any complex K3 surface X with any smooth Hermitian distance, any $m\geq 1$, nonempty compact convex $K\subset C^m$, neighborhood U of K and holomorphic $f:U\to X$, can f be approximated on K to arbitrary uniform accuracy by a holomorphic map $C^m\to X$? Nonprojective K3 surfaces are included. This is the convex approximation form of the Oka property.
